import pdftotext
import sys

def extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path, output_path=None):
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        pdf = pdftotext.PDF(f)
        text = "\n\n".join(pdf)

    if output_path:
        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as text_file:
            text_file.write(text)
    else:
        print(text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python script.py <pdf_file_path> [output_text_file_path]")
        sys.exit(1)

    pdf_file_path = sys.argv[1]
    output_text_file_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None

    extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_file_path, output_text_file_path)

import pdftotext
import sys

def extract_text_from_pdf(pdf_path, output_path=None):
    try:
        with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
            pdf = pdftotext.PDF(f)
            text = "\n\n".join(pdf)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Unable to open file: {pdf_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    if output_path:
        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as text_file:
            text_file.write(text)
    else:
        print(text)

def main():

        print("Usage: python script.py <pdf_file_path> [output_text_file_path]")
        sys.exit(1)

    pdf_file_path = sys.argv[1]
    output_text_file_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None

if __name__ == "__main__":
